item.title: Rent skates for two
item.summary: Two visitors work out rental sizes and return times at an ice rink.
item.transcript_text:
Aida: We need skates for the four o'clock session. I wear size thirty-eight, and my brother wears forty.
Clerk: We have thirty-eight, but the size forty pairs are still out. One should come back at ten to four.
Aida: Can we both go on the ice at four?
Clerk: Yes. I'll keep the next pair for your brother. Please collect both pairs together. Return them by quarter past five. You can leave your shoes on the shelf, but lockers need a coin.
Aida: We'll wait and collect the two pairs together.

questions.prompt: What are Aida and the clerk arranging?
options: Skate hire for two people before a session
A lesson for a first-time skater
An exchange for skates bought online
A booking for a private birthday group
questions.explanation: The clerk works out how Aida and her brother can collect both sizes and return them after the session.

questions.prompt: Which pair must they wait for?
options: The size they already have at home
questions.explanation: The clerk has size thirty-eight available now, while the size forty pairs are still out.

questions.prompt: When must they return the skates?
questions.explanation: The clerk specifically asks for both pairs back by 5:15.

questions.prompt: When do they need a coin?
options: To reserve the four o'clock session
To leave shoes on a shelf
To rent two pairs at once
questions.explanation: The shelf is available for shoes. The coin is for a locker.

children.segment_text: One should come back at ten to four.
